cards.english: to have one's head screwed on (be smart/sensible)
cards.examplePolish: On ma głowę na karku — zrobi to dobrze.
cards.exampleEnglish: He has his head screwed on — he'll do it well.

cards.english: on one's own, independently
cards.examplePolish: Zrobiła to na własną rękę.
cards.exampleEnglish: She did it on her own.

cards.english: to get up on the wrong side of bed
cards.examplePolish: Dzisiaj wstałem lewą nogą.
cards.exampleEnglish: I got up on the wrong side of bed today.

cards.english: the apple of one's eye, darling
cards.examplePolish: Ta córka to oczko w głowie rodziców.
cards.exampleEnglish: That daughter is the apple of her parents' eye.

cards.english: to take to one's heels, run away quickly
cards.examplePolish: Kiedy zobaczył policję, wziął nogi za pas.
cards.exampleEnglish: When he saw the police, he took to his heels.

cards.english: to be in seventh heaven (overjoyed)
cards.examplePolish: Po awansie jest w siódmym niebie.
cards.exampleEnglish: After the promotion she's in seventh heaven.

cards.english: to have had enough, to be fed up
cards.examplePolish: Mam już dość tej pracy.
cards.exampleEnglish: I've had enough of this job.

cards.english: to be in a fix, stuck in a difficult situation
cards.examplePolish: Jestem w kropce — nie wiem co zrobić.
cards.exampleEnglish: I'm in a fix — I don't know what to do.

cards.english: to come to light, to be revealed
cards.examplePolish: Wyszło na jaw, że skłamał.
cards.exampleEnglish: It came to light that he had lied.

cards.english: No problem! / No worries!
cards.examplePolish: — Przepraszam za spóźnienie. — Nie ma sprawy!
cards.exampleEnglish: — Sorry for being late. — No problem!

cards.english: No pain, no gain. (Without work, no cakes.)
cards.examplePolish: Musisz ćwiczyć codziennie — bez pracy nie ma kołaczy.
cards.exampleEnglish: You must practise daily — no pain, no gain.

cards.english: Better late than never.
cards.examplePolish: — Spóźniłeś się godzinę. — Lepiej późno niż wcale!
cards.exampleEnglish: — You're an hour late. — Better late than never!

cards.polish: Nie mój cyrk, nie moje małpy.
cards.english: Not my circus, not my monkeys. (Not my problem.)
cards.pronunciation: NYEH mooy TSYRK nyeh MOH-yeh MAH-wpy
cards.examplePolish: To ich problem — nie mój cyrk, nie moje małpy.
cards.exampleEnglish: That's their problem — not my circus, not my monkeys.

cards.polish: Nie wszystko złoto, co się świeci.
cards.english: All that glitters is not gold.
cards.pronunciation: nyeh VSHYST-koh ZWOH-toh tsoh sheh SHVYEH-tsee
cards.examplePolish: Uważaj — nie wszystko złoto, co się świeci.
cards.exampleEnglish: Be careful — all that glitters is not gold.

cards.english: to be right
cards.examplePolish: Masz rację, to dobry pomysł.
cards.exampleEnglish: You're right, that's a good idea.

cards.english: Give it a rest! / Leave it! / Forget it!
cards.examplePolish: Daj spokój, to i tak się nie uda.
cards.exampleEnglish: Give it a rest, it won't work anyway.

cards.english: what I mean is, what I'm getting at is
cards.examplePolish: Chodzi mi o to, że powinniśmy się spotkać.
cards.exampleEnglish: What I mean is, we should meet.

cards.english: in other words
cards.examplePolish: Innymi słowy, nie chcesz pomóc.
cards.exampleEnglish: In other words, you don't want to help.

cards.english: handyman, jack of all trades (lit: golden little hand)
cards.examplePolish: Tata to złota rączka — naprawił wszystko.
cards.exampleEnglish: Dad is a real handyman — he fixed everything.

cards.english: to work like an ox (to work very hard)
cards.examplePolish: Harowała jak wół, żeby zdać egzamin.
cards.exampleEnglish: She worked like an ox to pass the exam.

cards.english: at the eleventh hour, at the last minute
cards.examplePolish: Skończyłem pracę za pięć dwunasta.
cards.exampleEnglish: I finished the work at the last minute.

cards.english: not to lift a finger
cards.examplePolish: Nie ruszył palcem, żeby pomóc.
cards.exampleEnglish: He didn't lift a finger to help.

cards.english: with all one's heart, wholeheartedly
cards.examplePolish: Życzę ci z całego serca wszystkiego dobrego.
cards.exampleEnglish: I wish you with all my heart all the best.

cards.english: proverb, saying
cards.examplePolish: Jest polskie przysłowie: bez pracy nie ma kołaczy.
cards.exampleEnglish: There's a Polish proverb: no pain, no gain.

cards.english: idiom
cards.examplePolish: To jest popularny idiom w języku polskim.
cards.exampleEnglish: This is a popular idiom in Polish.
